QuestInfo.name: The Path of a Night Walker
QuestInfo.0: The time has come to make your choice. If you want to know about the Night Walker, the Thief of darkness, talk to the #bChief Knight of Darkness #p1101006##k.
QuestInfo.1: If you want to become a shadowy Night Walker of the Cygnus Knights, then select #p1101006#.
QuestInfo.2: You are now a Night Walker!

0.0: So you've willingly chosen to become a knight. How... curious. My name is #p1101006#, #bChief Knight of Darkness#k and #bleader of the Night Walkers#k. I suppose I'll have to keep you around if you choose this path.
0.2: Night Walkers are protected by the Spirit of Darkness. They are aided by #bUmbra, the spirit of darkness#k, but their powers go far beyond just spirits.
0.3: We operate in shadow, doing things to carry out justice other knights would never dirty their hands with. And that is all I am willing to share. If you wish to become a #bNight Walker#k, I will not stop you.

yes.0: Pursue a path that will leave you with no regrets.

0.1: Night Walkers are essentially Thieves. We attack from afar and #brely on luck and cunning to get past obstacles#k. I wonder if you have the cunning it takes to be one of us...
